Name: Dog Recolour - Black Labrador
Author: tebbbi
Description:
Recolours the 1st dog option to look more like a Black Lab!

Can be added mid-game if you selected the 1st dog or change to that dog via a mod or editing save files.

[size=3]Installation:[/size]

Unzip and put the folder into C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\mods

If using Vortex then just click[i] "Mod Manager Download"[/i]
